```yaml
name: Benchmarks

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmarks:
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        profile: minimal
        toolchain: stable
        override: true

    - name: Update bench.sh to use git for commit hash
      run: |
        sed -i '' 's/jj describe --hash HEAD/echo $(git rev-parse HEAD)/g' bench.sh

    - name: Run benchmarks
      run: ./bench.sh

    - name: Collect benchmark results
      id: collect_results
      run: |
        mkdir -p results
        cp *.json results/
        echo "::set-output name=results_dir::results"

    - name: Upload benchmark results
      uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/upload-benchmark-results@main
      with:
        benchmark-results-dir: ${{ steps.collect_results.outputs.results_dir }}
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Commit and push results
      uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
      with:
        commit_message: "Update benchmark results"
        branch: perf
        add_options: '--all'
        commit_user_name: github-actions[bot]
        commit_user_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
        push_options: '--force-with-lease'
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/benchmarks.yml` is designed to run on every push to the `main` branch and can also be triggered manually. It uses a macOS runner for consistent performance. The workflow collects benchmark results using the `bench.sh` script, updates it to fall back to git for commit hash when `jj` is not available, and then pushes these results to a dedicated 'perf' branch. Additionally, it includes a step to summarize the JSON results in the workflow summary.
yaml:
name: Benchmarks

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmarks:
    runs-on: macos-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        profile: minimal
        toolchain: stable
        override: true

    - name: Update bench.sh to use git for commit hash
      run: |
        sed -i '' 's/jj describe --hash HEAD/echo $(git rev-parse HEAD)/g' bench.sh

    - name: Run benchmarks
      run: ./bench.sh

    - name: Collect benchmark results
      id: collect_results
      run: |
        mkdir -p results
        cp *.json results/
        echo "::set-output name=results_dir::results"

    - name: Upload benchmark results
      uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/upload-benchmark-results@main
      with:
        benchmark-results-dir: ${{ steps.collect_results.outputs.results_dir }}
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Commit and push results
      uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
      with:
        commit_message: "Update benchmark results"
        branch: perf
        add_options: '--all'
        commit_user_name: github-actions[bot]
        commit_user_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
